_readme: One entry per video to generate with scripts/make_videos.py.
lines: what the character says (shown as subtitles too). The first line matches the quote on the video slide.
voice: picked automatically from HeyGen voices by language + accent; set voice_id to force a specific voice (see --list-voices).
background: image to put behind the character. If the file is missing, the character keeps the background from its photo.
background_brief: description for making that image (see BACKGROUNDS.md).
settings.person_height: how tall the photo is in the frame (0.9 = 90%). Lower = smaller person, more background. Change it, then remake with --force.
